info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Documents-v5-spec
info.description: The List Mortgage Loans Documents API provides users with easy access to all the documents associated with mortgage loans. This API enables users to retrieve detailed records of loan-related documents, facilitating efficient management and organization of mortgage portfolios. Typical consumers include mortgage professionals, financial institutions, and real estate companies who need to track and manage documentation. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can integrate document retrieval into their workflows to improve operational efficiency and compliance.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve all documents associated with loans. You can use this to check the documentation status, fetch relevant files, or verify the submitted documents for each loan.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve loan documents. It must be formatted as JSON and contain the necessary parameters to specify which loan documents are being requested.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of loan documents.

ListMortgageLoansDocumentsRequest.description: A request body for the GET operation concerning loan documents in JSON format.

ListMortgageLoansDocumentsResponse_200.title: Loan Document Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the loan document.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit trail related to the loan document operation.

ListMortgageLoansDocumentsResponse_200.description: The response object containing the details of the loan document operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information
